name: Flipkart
h1: Scale Minutes and get IPO ready, on one connected layer
lede: Flipkart has moved its holding structure home to India and is expanding Flipkart Minutes at pace while it readies for a listing. Airtable connects the launch, expansion and readiness work behind both.
why_h2: Restructured, expanding and preparing to list
why_p: A completed re-domiciliation, a fast-growing quick commerce network and a paused but live IPO plan all add programmes that cut across teams.

signals.title: Re-domiciliation to India completed
signals.body: Flipkart completed the shift of its holding company from Singapore to India after NCLT and Government of India approvals, making Flipkart Internet the group holding entity ahead of a planned listing.
signals.angle: Run entity, compliance and readiness workstreams from one tracker with clear owners and evidence.

signals.title: Flipkart Minutes passes 800 dark stores
signals.body: TechCrunch reported Flipkart Minutes had crossed 800 dark stores, with UBS expecting the network to double by the end of 2026 as Flipkart and Amazon press quick commerce startups.
signals.angle: Give site selection, launch checklists and city rollouts one shared pipeline instead of parallel spreadsheets.

signals.title: IPO placed on hold
signals.body: Flipkart reportedly paused its IPO indefinitely citing volatile markets and a crowded listings pipeline, having targeted a SEBI draft filing in late 2026 or early 2027.
signals.angle: Keep readiness work warm and visible so the programme can restart quickly when the window reopens.
